title: Police Blotter: 14 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Fourteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Nov. 24–25, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — DWI, family-violence assault, marijuana possession and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Fourteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Tuesday and Wednesday, November 24–25, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge or hold shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Julio De La Torre

De La Torre was arrested on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 3:20 a.m. on charges of assault causing bodily injury, a Class A misdemeanor; evading arrest or detention, a Class A misdemeanor; and possession of marijuana, less than two ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $3,000 on each of the first two charges and $1,000 on the possession charge. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Arturo Pulido-Rodriguez

Pulido-Rodriguez was arrested on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 3:16 a.m. on charges of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor, and assault causing bodily injury, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $10,000 on the driving while intoxicated charge and $5,000 on the assault charge. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Jorge Alonzo Diaz Jr.

Diaz was taken into custody by Homeland Security on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 5:16 a.m. on a federal violation, a federal hold with the United States Marshals. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Osbaldo Garcia III

Garcia was taken into custody by Homeland Security on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 5:21 a.m. on a federal violation, a federal hold with the United States Marshals. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Miguel Resendez-Martinez

Resendez-Martinez was taken into custody by Homeland Security on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 5:14 a.m. as a material witness on a federal violation, a federal hold with the United States Marshals. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Gumercindo Orta-Cardelas

Orta-Cardelas was taken into custody by Homeland Security on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 5:06 a.m. as a material witness on a federal violation, a federal hold with the United States Marshals. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Erick Davilla-Martinez

Davilla-Martinez was taken into custody by Homeland Security on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 5:13 a.m. as a material witness on a federal violation, a federal hold with the United States Marshals. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Hector Hugo Mojica

Mojica was arrested on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 7:34 a.m. on a charge of possession of marijuana, less than two ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $500 on a personal recognizance bond. He was released on November 25, 2026. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Juan Daniel Martinez-Martinez

Martinez-Martinez was arrested on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 10:28 a.m. on a charge of an accident involving damage to a vehicle of $200 or more, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $501. He is also being held on an out-of-county/immigration hold by Customs and Border Protection.

Angel Ivan Cruz

Cruz was arrested on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 12:18 p.m. on a charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Jorge Leyva

Leyva was arrested on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 2:57 p.m. on charges of terroristic threat of family or household, a Class A misdemeanor, and criminal mischief of $750 to less than $2,500, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set on either charge at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Miguel Angel Flores

Flores was arrested on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 5:17 p.m. on a charge of terroristic threat causing fear of imminent serious bodily injury, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $2,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Ruben Ramos

Ramos was arrested on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 6:07 p.m. on a charge of possession of marijuana, less than two ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $2,005. He is also being held on an out-of-county hold. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Marline Annet Galvez

Galvez was arrested on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 6:21 p.m. on a charge of criminal trespass, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.
